userStories.title: Thread backend into the readPhaseModel drift-guard test
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need the per-phase drift-guard test to resolve the phase backend first and pass it to readPhaseModel, with a backend-aware `expected` value, so that the guard validates the spawn-accurate model and does not falsely redden for a future [models.<backend>]-only codex phase.
acceptanceCriteria: In the 'readPhaseModel vs repo project.toml (drift guard)' describe block of test/config/models.test.ts, readPhaseBackend(phase, repoConfigPath) is resolved BEFORE the readPhaseModel call and passed as the third positional argument: readPhaseModel(phase, repoConfigPath, backend). [oracle: file-assert grep -n 'readPhaseModel(phase, repoConfigPath, backend)' test/config/models.test.ts]

The `expected` value compared against `actual` in the equality assertion is derived with the same backend-aware resolution order as readPhaseModel: nested [models.<backend>].<phase> (only when backend !== 'claude' and the value is a non-empty string), then flat [models].<phase>, then DEFAULTS[phase]; so the equality assertion holds for both a claude phase and a hypothetical [models.<backend>]-only codex phase. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The drift guard still reads the REAL repo config (scripts/cam/project.toml via process.cwd()); no tmp fixture is introduced. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "join(process.cwd(), 'scripts', 'cam', 'project.toml')" test/config/models.test.ts]

No production source file is modified; the change is confined to test/config/models.test.ts (readPhaseModel already accepts the optional backend param). [oracle: file-assert git diff --name-only main -- src | grep -qv . || ! git diff --name-only main | grep -q '^src/']
Every per-phase drift-guard case is green against the committed all-claude scripts/cam/project.toml. [oracle: bun test test/config/models.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file test change. Target: test/config/models.test.ts, describe block 'readPhaseModel vs repo project.toml (drift guard)' (~lines 750-773). readPhaseModel signature is (phase, configPath?, backend?) in src/config/models.ts:158 - do NOT add a param or touch any source file. Resolution order to mirror in `expected`: readNestedBackendModel returns undefined when backend omitted OR === 'claude' (falls through to flat [models].<phase> string lookup, then DEFAULTS[phase]) - see src/config/models.ts:120-177. Gotcha: threading backend into `actual` WITHOUT also making `expected` backend-aware merely relocates the latent false-redden from the isClaudeAliasModel assertion (line ~769) to the equality assertion (lines ~762-763); update both. For the committed all-claude config this is a no-op today and the suite stays green. Keep reading the real repo config, not a tmp fixture.
